accessControlModal.description.useThisPo: Use this policy to restrict access to groups of resources.
accessControlModal.text.allowOnlySpecifi: Allow only specified network protocols. To change traffic direction and ports, select
accessControlModal.text.selectNetBirdSSH: Select NetBird SSH for SSH-specific policies with fine-grained access control, or use TCP with port 22 for basic network-level SSH access
accessControlModal.text.typicallyAGroupO: Typically a group of user devices (e.g., Developers, Marketing) or individual devices in peer-to-peer connections that will access the destination.
Typically a group of peers or resources (e.g., Servers, Databases, Internal Services) that will be accessed by the source. Can also be an individual peer or resource.
accessControlModal.text.someDestinationG: Some destination groups contain resources. Resources only support incoming traffic and cannot initiate connections.
accessControlModal.text.sSHAccessOnlyWor: SSH access only works on peers, not on routed resources. Please ensure your destination groups contain peers for SSH connectivity.
accessControlModal.text.toAllowSSHAsAny: to allow SSH as any local user, or
accessControlModal.text.toSpecifyWhichLo: to specify which local users each group is allowed to use.
accessControlModal.text.allowNetworkTraf: Allow network traffic and access only to specified ports. Select ports or port ranges between 1 and 65535.
accessControlModal.helpText.useThisSwitc: Use this switch to enable or disable the policy.
accessControlModal.text.setAnEasilyIdent: Set an easily identifiable name for your policy.
accessControlModal.text.writeAShortDescr: Write a short description to add more context to this policy.
